Title: REPTILE JACKET IN CONTOURED CUT
Body (HTML): A sharply contoured jacket with a feminine line, cut from heavy Swiss denim and panelled in crocodile-embossed nappa leather. The high collar is lined in nappa, so it sits soft against the neck, and closes with a signature lock fastening that gives the piece its own character. Buttoned cuffs open at the wrist, and a concealed zip pocket on the inside keeps cash and personal essentials out of sight. Lined in royal purple. Worn with the matching trousers, it reads as a classy uniform with an avant-garde touch.
